posts.description: A browser orbital simulator. Set up satellites around Earth or a small body, propagate them, and play the result back on a 3D globe, a Mercator ground-track map and drift charts.

posts.title: On Space Warfare With Unconventional Weapons
posts.description: Every single day, every single hour, every single minute, thousands of satellites orbit us: silently serving us in many different ways. Multiple networks of satellites run our world, they tell us how the wind blows, where road traffic flows, they talk of harvest good and bad, they monitor threats of nature and nurture. posts.title: Domestic Use Gas Cylinders from India's Coal Power Plants
posts.description: India imports 21 million tonnes of LPG a year, which is a supply chain risk at a national scale. Walking through the six-reaction chain that could let existing coal plants make cooking gas instead.
